title: Completed scan configuration
statement: Given a symbol alphabet, a number $k$ of work tapes, a selected tape $i<k$, a word $w$, and a configuration $d$ for input $x$ and the writing phases associated to $w$, define a configuration with the same fields as $d$ except that its state is the done phase and its work-tape contents are those of the forward scan performed with parameter $|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A configuration $d$ for input $x$ and the phases associated to $w$
caveat: The work-tape contents are delegated to a word-scanning operation whose definition is not included in the payload.
